desc_en: A sculpted silhouette defines this short sleeve crew neck bodysuit. Crafted to precisely follow the natural curves of the body with a soft and flexible touch. The design incorporates a bottom snap button closure for enhanced functionality. A versatile piece designed for seamless transitions between day and evening occasions. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.

El diseño incorpora un cierre inferior con botones a presión para mayor funcionalidad. Una prenda versátil pensada para la transición entre ocasiones formales e informales. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
